title: AI Intake routing configuration
description: Who receives warm transfers, in what order, at what hours. Loaded and hot-reloaded by the intake service. Real numbers live in routing.json, which is not committed.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to evaluate businessHours and holidays.

businessHours.description: Staffed hours per weekday as [open, close] in 24h HH:MM local time, or null for closed. Outside these hours the overnight list is used.

holidays.description: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD, local) treated as outside business hours all day.

staff.description: Every person the agent can transfer to, keyed by a short id used in the lists below.

intake.description: Ordered priority lists for new-client transfers, per caller language. Bilingual staff appear on both.

admin.description: Ordered list for existing-client and other-matter transfers.

overnight.description: Ordered list used for intake transfers outside businessHours. Should contain bilingual staff or the flow will whisper in English regardless of caller language.

handlesExistingClients.description: If true, the overnight list also fills the admin slots outside business hours. If false, existing clients after hours get the fallback message and a morning callback Task.

seniorManagement.description: First names of senior management. Callers asking for these people are routed to the intake list. The loader rejects any staff entry whose name contains one of these (case-insensitive) so they can never be a transfer target.

callbackWindow.description: What the agent promises in the fallback message, per hours bucket and language.

name.description: Spoken by the agent in the hold message and whisper. First name is enough.

email.description: Receives the fallback alert when this person is first on the list.

salesforceUserId.description: Salesforce User Id. Becomes the Lead owner when this person accepts a transfer. Optional; the queue is used if absent.

staffList.description: Ordered staff ids, first is tried first. At most 3; the flow has three transfer slots per list.
